The total thermal resistance per unit area is calculated by summing the conductive resistances of all layers and the convective resistances at the inner and outer surfaces. The heat flux is the temperature difference divided by the total resistance. The temperature at the interface between layers 3 and 4 is found by subtracting the product of heat flux and the resistance from the inside air to that interface from the indoor temperature.

- Inside convective resistance: \(R_{\text{conv,in}} = 1/9 = 0.111111\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 1 (glass wool): \(R_1 = 0.025/0.04 = 0.625\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 2 (plaster): \(R_2 = 0.28/0.5 = 0.56\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 3 (gypsum board): \(R_3 = 0.12/0.17 \approx 0.705882\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 4 (stone): \(R_4 = 0.14/2.3 \approx 0.060870\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 5 (cork): \(R_5 = 0.03/0.043 \approx 0.697674\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 6 (concrete): \(R_6 = 0.285/1.4 = 0.203571\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 7 (glass wool): \(R_7 = 0.03/0.04 = 0.75\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Layer 8 (gypsum board): \(R_8 = 0.07/0.17 \approx 0.411765\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)
- Outside convective resistance: \(R_{\text{conv,out}} = 1/20 = 0.05\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\)

Total resistance \(R_{\text{total}} = 4.1758735823\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\). Temperature difference \(\Delta T = 21 - (-6) = 27\, \text{K}\). Heat flux \(q = \Delta T / R_{\text{total}} = 6.465712977 \approx 6.466\, \text{W/m}^2\) (4 significant figures).

Resistance from inside air to interface of layers 3 and 4: \(R_{\text{up}} = R_{\text{conv,in}} + R_1 + R_2 + R_3 = 2.0019934641\, \text{m}^2\!\cdot\!\text{K/W}\). Temperature drop from inside air to interface: \(q \times R_{\text{up}} = 12.94431512\, \text{K}\). Interface temperature: \(21 - 12.94431512 = 8.05568488 \approx 8.056\,^\circ\text{C}\) (4 significant figures).
